title: Descriptor Vector Contract
description: Schema for the output of the thermodynamic descriptor computation pipeline.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the alloy sample.

experimental_validation_status.description: Indicates whether the sample has been confirmed by experimental validation (e.g., XRD). 'yes' if confirmed, 'no' if explicitly excluded, 'unknown' if data is missing or not yet assessed.

error_code.description: Error code if the composition was invalid, null otherwise.
